$comment: Reviewed payloads of the finished installers (open-source-release-2026-09-29 P-017, WI-10003906). Read by scripts/check-licenses.mjs --installer-tree, which audit-release-bundle.py --scan-artifact --licenses runs on every platform's finished installer. Each entry covers the files matching its path globs (relative to the unpacked installer; `**` spans directories, members of a nested archive are addressed `<archive>!/<member>`). A nested archive matched by an entry is covered whole and not expanded. Add an entry only after reading the component's real license text. kind: first-party | program | library | model | os-image | bundle. `aggregate: true` marks a separate program shipped beside the app under a copyleft license (allowed; its source must be offered). Model weights need kind "model": a package's code license never covers them.

components.name: Papercusp first-party binaries and packages
components.reason: Built from this repository. Their third-party dependencies are gated by the npm and Cargo lockfile legs of the same check.

components.name: Node.js runtime
components.reason: Official Node.js binary. MIT; its bundled components (OpenSSL Apache-2.0, ICU Unicode, libuv MIT, V8 BSD-3-Clause) are permissive.
components.obligations: Ship Node's LICENSE file (it lists the bundled components).

components.name: PostgreSQL client tools linked with GNU readline
components.reason: pg_dump/pg_dumpall/pg_restore/psql are PostgreSQL-licensed, but .pg-real/lib ships libreadline.so.8 (GPL-3.0-or-later) and libtinfo, so the shipped psql is a GPL-3 combination. It runs as a separate program the app invokes, not linked into the app.
components.obligations: Offer the corresponding source of readline (and psql) with the release, or rebuild psql against libedit to drop the GPL component.

components.name: GitHub CLI (gh)
components.reason: Official gh release binary, MIT. Syft reports its compiled-in Go modules; they are part of this program.

components.name: Kopia
components.reason: Official kopia release binary, Apache-2.0. Syft reports its compiled-in Go modules; they are part of this program.

components.name: Ubuntu 24.04 runtime root filesystem
components.reason: A container export of an Ubuntu 24.04 base plus runtime packages, run as a separate environment. Its packages keep their own licenses (many GPL/LGPL programs); Syft finds 220 Debian packages and cannot read their licenses because the export strips /usr/share/doc.
components.obligations: Name the image and its package list in the third-party notices and point to the Ubuntu archive for GPL/LGPL corresponding source.

components.name: EmbeddingGemma 300M (ONNX)
components.reason: onnx-community conversion of google/embeddinggemma-300m, model card license: gemma. The Gemma Terms of Use permit redistribution under conditions; this is not an open-source license.
components.obligations: Ship the notice 'Gemma is provided under and subject to the Gemma Terms of Use found at ai.google.dev/gemma/terms', a copy of the terms, and pass the use restrictions (Prohibited Use Policy) on to users.

components.name: Harrier OSS v1 0.6B (ONNX)
components.reason: onnx-community conversion of microsoft/harrier-oss-v1-0.6b, model card license: mit.

components.name: Silero VAD models
components.reason: Silero VAD weights (snakers4/silero-vad, MIT), copied into the SPA from @ricky0123/vad-web.

components.name: Porcupine wake-word parameters
components.reason: porcupine_params.pv ships inside @picovoice/porcupine-web (declared Apache-2.0) and the Picovoice/porcupine repository (Apache-2.0). Running Porcupine requires a Picovoice AccessKey under Picovoice's terms of service; that is a service condition, not a redistribution term.
components.obligations: Users need their own Picovoice AccessKey; state that in the third-party notices.
